name: Bear Slant Strong
formation: Bear Front vs Under-Center 21 Personnel Strong Right

summary.motive: Trade gap-control patience for instant backfield penetration against gap runs, using synchronized one-gap movement so every blocker chases while the carrier runs into occupied gaps.
summary.keyDefender: NOSE slanting to strong B — he lands exactly where the lead blocker is aiming
summary.whyItWorks: Simultaneous movement means every combo is blocking the man who just left, while the replacing linebacker erases the backside escape hatch.
summary.failureMode: Reach blocks: if the front-side tackle hooks the slanting end, the entire slant chain gets reached and the run bounces outside.

beats.title: 1. The Strong-Slant Picture
beats.text: The Bear front stacks its double 4is and zero-nose over the guards while the offense lines up strong right — every interior blocker is staring at a defender he cannot reach-block.

beats.title: 2. Three Bodies Cross One Direction
beats.text: All three interior linemen rip across their blockers’ faces simultaneously, landing in strong A, B, and C before any combo has time to climb.

beats.title: 3. Backside Replacement
beats.text: MIKE scrapes into the weak A the slanting 4iL abandoned while FS closes the cutback hatch behind him — nothing opens anywhere on the play.

beats.title: 4. Met Head-On in the Hole
beats.text: The FB lead arrives to find NOSE already owning strong B, and the tailback is swallowed at the line by the converging slant wall.

relations.tell: All three interior linemen tilt their stances and stagger their steps strong during the cadence — the goal-line Bear sits flat-footed until the ball is snapped.
